metadata.name: customs-trade-compliance
metadata.description: Codified customs and trade compliance expertise — HS/HTS tariff classification with GRI rules, commercial invoices and entry documentation, Incoterms 2020, FTA qualification and duty optimization (USMCA, RCEP, FTZs, drawback), denied-party screening, and penalty mitigation across US, EU, UK, and APAC jurisdictions. Use when classifying goods, preparing import/export documentation, screening restricted parties, responding to customs audits or CF-28/penalty notices, or optimizing duties.
